figures.title: Pipeline funnel
figures.caption: No row is ever dropped — every fix changes columns, not rows. The split happens last, after row-wise cleaning that learns nothing from the data.

figures.title: 'unknown' co-occurrence
figures.caption: Diagonal = 100%. housing and loan are unknown on exactly the same 990 rows — one missing source, not two. default=unknown (20.87%) is mostly independent of the rest.

figures.title: 'unknown' per column
figures.caption: The UCI metadata says there are no missing values. These six columns disagree.

figures.title: Class balance
figures.caption: Only 11.27% subscribe. Predicting 'no' for everyone scores 88.73% accuracy — which is why accuracy is never the headline metric here.

figures.title: duration — the leak
figures.caption: Mean 221s for 'no' vs 553s for 'yes'. No call under 37s ever ended in a subscription — and the length is only known after hanging up.

figures.title: Correlation heatmap
figures.caption: emp.var.rate, euribor3m and nr.employed correlate at 0.91–0.97: three columns carrying one signal, 'the state of the economy'. Note pdays is the raw column here (999 sentinel included).

figures.title: poutcome
figures.caption: The strongest legitimate predictor: clients whose previous campaign succeeded subscribe at 65%.

figures.title: contact
figures.caption: Cellular contacts convert nearly 3× better than landline — but channel may proxy for client type.

figures.title: job
figures.caption: Students and retirees respond most; blue-collar least. Note the sample sizes.

figures.title: education
figures.caption: education=illiterate shows 22.2% from only 18 rows — see the small-sample trap.

figures.title: day_of_week
figures.caption: Nearly flat. A feature that does nothing is itself a finding.

figures.title: The month volume–rate inversion
figures.caption: May has the most calls (13,769) and the worst rate (6.43%); March has 546 calls and 50.55%. This may reflect campaign strategy, not client behaviour — no causal claim.

figures.title: Numeric features by class
figures.caption: Subscribers cluster at low euribor3m / nr.employed — the crisis period. campaign is heavily skewed: median 2, max 56.

figures.title: Stratified split
figures.caption: Stratification keeps the 11.27% rate identical in train and test.
